entities.name: Luigi de' Rossi

entities.summary: Luigi de' Rossi (1474–1519) was an Italian Roman Catholic cardinal of San Clemente best known for being wearing red cardinal's robes in Raphael's Portrait of Leo X, with his hand rested on the back of the pope's chair.
